findings.passage: “No one, regardless of their zip code or where they call home, should live in fear of gun violence, and yet tragically too many Delawareans have lived this pain firsthand,”
findings.note: Statement by Coons in a GIFFORDS PAC endorsement release (an outside group's page quoting him). The same release says he passed the NICS Denial Notification Act, which makes federal authorities alert state and local police when a prohibited buyer fails a background check.

findings.passage: "There are things we should do to make it harder for people with mental health problems, people who are convicted felons, people who have domestic violence convictions, from easily getting guns," Coons said.
findings.note: Quoted by CBS News from Face the Nation after the Parkland shooting. He names limits on who may easily get guns and says bipartisan background-check bills had not been acted on.
subjects: limits on who may have a gun

findings.passage: "I am not optimistic that until there is real action by the American public to demand change in Congress, that we're going to see real action to confront gun violence out of this Congress," Coons said.
findings.note: Quoted by CBS News on Face the Nation; he says Congress has failed to act on gun violence and says the party in control of the floor decides what gets a vote.
